crop.notes: main headline 'MR. "BOB" FARRELL, EX-LIGHTWEIGHT.' is cut off; crop starts at the subhead. Body is complete.

ocr.notes: first half good; second half (from the Coburn contest on) badly garbled

title.suggested: Bob Farrell, Ex-Lightweight, Suggested as Referee

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch profiled Bob Farrell, St. Louis boxing instructor proposed as referee for Corbett-Fitzsimmons, listing among his early New York victims a boxer called "Young Tom Allen."

metadata.notes: masthead: Sunday Morning, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, October 20, 1895, page 32

notes: The only mention is 'Young Tom Allen and "Fiddler" Neary were his next victims' among Farrell's early New York lightweight bouts. 'Young Tom Allen' is probably a different, younger boxer, not the champion; a human should decide whether to keep this article. No facts recorded.
